matrix_policy: One axis at a time plus reviewed worst-case combinations; never Cartesian-expand all axes. Respect bounded worker time/memory and record stopped/incomplete cases.

live and revoked evidence intermixed across retained history

correctness_gate: Compare structured scoped outcomes/blockers, evidence dependencies, revisions and effect-attempt states under declared representation relation.
Resolve theorem/evidence identities through pinned native context; matching display text or JSON alone is insufficient.
Candidate must pass negative/refusal/late-event cases before latency comparison is eligible.
No dropped requests, truncated evidence, suppressed diagnostics or changed completeness may be counted as optimization.
measurement_schedule: Root schedules isolated service slot through build steward.
Compile/admit bundles outside warm request spans; preserve build/qualification costs separately.
Fresh isolated state for every pair, discarded explicit warmup, alternating baseline/candidate order.
Record individual repetitions, quantile method, cold/first/warm identities and interference; choose repetition count after pilot variance.
Record steps, live_goals invocations, evidence/table traversals and binding checks alongside CPU/wall/allocations/GC/peak live memory.
Report correctness and performance together, including timeout/memory/refusal outcomes and amortization over retained session length.
refinement_hypothesis: Indexed request/evidence maps, dependency snapshots or cached live-goal calculations may improve list-scan scaling, but require invalidation/epoch correctness and generated representation refinement. No measured hotspot or speedup is claimed.
remaining_interface: bounded source and goal-DAG fixture constructor
